title: Gene conservation and loss
study: Touchon et al. 2009 · Supplementary Table S1, K12 sheet
description: Actual functional / absent / pseudogene calls across 21 E. coli, Shigella and E. fergusonii genomes for the 81 genes listed as pseudogenes in K-12. This is a deliberately variable gene subset, not the complete core genome.
reference: 21 strains as named in the published Table S1
processing: Read the K12 sheet of the original XLS workbook. Keep all 81 rows and the 21 published state columns; count functional state = 1 without changing absent = 0 or pseudogene = -1. Coordinates omitted because the reference gene can belong to another strain.
